turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Sunday. How is your weekend going so far in Austin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going pretty well, thanks. Just having a relaxing morning. I started things off with an oat milk latte, which was exactly what I needed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An oat milk latte sounds like the perfect Sunday morning start. Are you just relaxing at home today, or do you have some plans lined up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit of both. I'm just hanging around the apartment right now. I threw on a fitted t-shirt and some shorts, and I'm just taking it easy before I figure out the rest of my afternoon.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice and casual, love it. Sometimes those slow Sunday mornings are the best. Are you planning on making any lunch soon, or maybe grabbing something?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I just finished eating a homemade salad. Kept it simple and fresh since it's pretty warm today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A homemade salad is a great choice, especially in this Texas heat. It's been a while since we caught up about your family—how are things going with your sister Ana's wedding coming up in November?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Things are going well! She's getting a lot of the final details sorted out. It's crazy how fast November is approaching, but everyone is really excited.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It really does fly by! It's going to be such a special celebration. Have you had any time to play your guitar or do any rock climbing this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually spent about an hour playing my guitar yesterday evening, practicing some new chords. I haven't gone climbing this weekend, but I might try to head to the gym sometime next week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's awesome. Getting some solid practice in always feels rewarding, and climbing next week sounds like a great plan to look forward to. Are you and Sam up to anything tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not much, just planning on a quiet evening. Sam's out doing his own thing, so I'll probably just watch a movie and relax.
